title: Eliminate SQL Injection Vulnerabilities
problem_statement: Legacy VB6 code uses string concatenation for SQL queries, creating critical security vulnerabilities that must be resolved before modernization
risk_if_unaddressed: Complete database compromise, unauthorized balance modifications, regulatory violations, potential financial fraud
suggested_approach: Replace string concatenation with parameterized queries using Entity Framework or Dapper in C# implementation. Implement input validation and sanitization.
success_criteria: All SQL queries use parameterized statements
Static analysis confirms no string concatenation in database queries
Penetration testing validates SQL injection prevention

provenance.evidence: txtAccountNo.Text directly concatenated into SQL WHERE clause
txtAmount.Text directly concatenated into SQL UPDATE statement

title: Implement Banking Transaction Controls
problem_statement: Legacy code lacks transaction boundaries, concurrency control, and audit trails required for banking operations
risk_if_unaddressed: Race conditions in balance updates, lost transactions, regulatory compliance failures, inability to audit financial operations
suggested_approach: Implement database transactions with proper isolation levels, add optimistic concurrency control, create comprehensive audit logging for all balance changes
success_criteria: All balance operations wrapped in database transactions
Complete audit trail for all financial operations

provenance.evidence: UPDATE statement lacks transaction boundaries and concurrency control

title: Design Data Migration Strategy
problem_statement: No clear path defined for migrating from VB6 ADO Recordset patterns to modern C# data access while preserving exact behavioral compatibility
risk_if_unaddressed: Data loss during migration, behavioral regressions, extended downtime, inability to rollback if issues occur
suggested_approach: Create comprehensive mapping between VB6 ADO patterns and C# Entity Framework, implement side-by-side testing, develop rollback procedures
success_criteria: 100% functional parity between VB6 and C# implementations
Performance benchmarks meet or exceed legacy system

provenance.evidence: VB6 Recordset.Open pattern requires complete architectural change

title: Implement Authentication and Authorization
problem_statement: No authentication or authorization mechanisms visible in current system, critical for banking application security
risk_if_unaddressed: Unauthorized access to banking functions, regulatory compliance violations, potential financial fraud
suggested_approach: Implement OAuth2/OpenID Connect with role-based access control, integrate with existing bank identity systems, add session management
success_criteria: Role-based access control for banking operations
Integration with bank's identity management system

provenance.evidence: No authentication modules detected in 304 scanned files
